description: This file implements a ProseMirror plugin for table column resizing, including handling resize handles, user interactions, and updating column widths within a rich text editor.

methods.name: createResizeState
methods.description: Creates and updates the resize state based on transactions and user interactions.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles the initiation of column resize on mouse or touch events.

methods.name: currentColWidth
methods.description: Calculates the current width of a table column.

methods.name: edgeCell
methods.description: Finds the position of the edge cell (left or right) in a table row.

methods.name: draggedWidth
methods.description: Calculates the new width during dragging based on cursor movement.

methods.name: updateColumnWidth
methods.description: Updates the column width attributes in the table nodes.

methods.name: displayColumnWidth
methods.description: Updates the visual display of column widths in the DOM.

methods.name: zeroes
methods.description: Creates an array of zeros of specified length.

methods.name: createColumnResizeHandles
methods.description: Creates resize handle decorations for table cells.

methods.name: createResizeHandle
methods.description: Creates a DOM element for a resize handle.
